'''Warren Keith Sinclair''' (9 March 1924 – 14 May 2014) was an international expert in radiation protection, science and medicine.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.ncrponline.org/Press_Rel/2014/WKS_obit.pdf|title=International Expert in Radiation Protection, Science and Medicine Warren Keith Sinclair (1924 to 2014)|publisher=ncrponline.org}}</ref>
